boardClassCaps.rationale: Positive control passed at 8ms/frame. No sign-consistent or above-noise caps-off regression was measured.

mapConnectionCap.rationale: The 2200 cap deterministically keeps an order-biased prefix and omits 7800 connections without nearest-first or semantic ranking. Performance evidence cannot decide whether that visual result is acceptable.

caveats: Absolute frame-rate values on this continuously loaded host are noise and are not used as authoritative gates.
p95 frame gaps are retained only as a quantized diagnostic. The primary comparison is continuous CDP renderer TaskDuration normalized per capture second.

The committed sceneDerivationMsP95 values (4.5ms caps-on / 5.9ms caps-off) were captured before A4 (#324) moved full-board card metric derivation out of createBoardScene. Post-A4 captures time only createBoardScene and are not directly comparable on this metric.

Absolute TaskDuration ms/s values include the capture sampler (about 45ms/frame, mostly forced overview drawing) and are not production-cost measurements. Only paired arm deltas are decision-grade; the sampler cost is arm-independent, so it cancels in the comparison.
Host load is observational context only; captures are never delayed or rejected because of it.
A passing positive control establishes sensitivity at 8ms of synthetic work per animation frame; it does not establish sensitivity below that level.
The visual acceptability of omitting 7800 order-biased connections is not a performance conclusion and remains a human decision.
